subject: general
question: What is the primary purpose of the vertical planetary mixer developed by ISRO in Feb 2025?

options.text: To develop new materials for spacecraft
To create advanced propulsion systems for deep space missions
To enhance the efficiency and safety of solid rocket motor manufacturing

solution:
The correct answer is __**To enhance the efficiency and safety of solid rocket motor manufacturing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **vertical planetary mixer** developed by ISRO in **February 2025** is designed to **enhance the efficiency and safety** in the production of solid rocket motors.
 
• This technology supports precise mixing of propellant ingredients, ensuring consistent quality and composition for **better performance of rockets**.
 
• Solid rocket motors are critical components in many launch vehicles, including those used for satellite deployment and interplanetary missions.
 
• The mixer integrates advanced mechanical design and automation features to **reduce human intervention**, minimizing risks associated with hazardous materials.
 
• ISRO has been focusing on innovations to streamline the manufacturing process of solid propulsion systems, which are vital for India’s space missions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solid Rocket Motors:**

 
 
• Solid rocket motors use a solid propellant mixture that is ignited to produce thrust.
 
• They are simpler and more reliable compared to liquid propulsion systems but require meticulous manufacturing processes for consistent results.
 
• Propellant mixtures generally include oxidizers, fuel, and binders.
 
 
 
• **Planetary Mixers:**
 
 
• Planetary mixers are specialized machines designed for mixing viscous materials uniformly.
 
• They are widely used in industries like food, chemical, and aerospace manufacturing.
 
• The "vertical" design enhances efficiency by reducing material settling and ensuring thorough mixing.
 
 
 
• **ISRO’s Advancements in Propulsion:**
 
 
• ISRO has developed several propulsion technologies, including cryogenic engines and solid rocket boosters.
 
• Solid propulsion systems are used in the PSLV and GSLV series for launching satellites into orbit.
 
• Continuous advancements aim to improve reliability, safety, and cost-effectiveness.
 
 
 
• **Safety Considerations in Propellant Manufacturing:**
 
 
• Propellant manufacturing involves handling hazardous chemicals and explosive materials.
 
• Automation and specialized equipment like vertical planetary mixers reduce the risks associated with human errors.
 
• Safety protocols and advanced designs are integral to ensuring worker safety and environmental protection.
